newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Photo subsidiary buys U.S. chemical firm.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Photo subsidiary buys U.S. chemical firm.

text.p: Fuji Photo Film Co Ltd said on Thursday that its U.S. subsidiary had bought a chemical firm based in Tennessee for about one billion yen.

The Fuji subsidiary, Fuji Hunt Photographic Chemicals Inc, bought Tennessee Valley Performance Products Co to use the chemical firm's technology for developing new ventures, including pharmaceutical products, a company spokesman said.
The acquired firm makes catalysts and additives and distributes them to large chemical companies, he said.
Tennessee Valley Performance has been renamed Fuji Hunt Specialty Products Co, he said.
